url.description: A pasted posting, apply or publication URL in any SmartRecruiters shape; api. and www. URLs are parsed only, the program reads the posting from jobs.smartrecruiters.com. sections.heading: Company Description
sections.html: Feldco is a leading home renewal company specializing in delighting our customers through our products: windows, siding, and doors.
sections.text: Feldco is a leading home renewal company specializing in delighting our customers through our products: windows, siding, and doors.

sections.heading: Job Description
sections.html:
We are looking for Outside Sales Representatives to join our successful, highly-motivated team at Feldco, the #1 Window, Siding and Door Company in the USA (recognized by Window and Door Magazine). We have 40 years of experience in delighting customers by making home improvement projects simple.


What We Can Offer You?


Leadership -- We are the #1 Replacement Window, Door and Siding Company in America! We take great pride in our leadership and transformation of the home improvement market. 


Growth -- We have more than quadrupled our business over the past few years and are presently expanding into more new markets.


Advancement -- We have recently promoted many internal staff members to senior management positions and offer external training.


Security -- We operate profitably and are enhancing the benefits and care of our employees.


Professionalism -- We are investing heavily in quality improvements and establishing industry-best operations.


Teamwork -- We are focused on assisting each other and working together to take care of our customers.


Location: Evergreen Park, IL


Responsibilities:

• Respond to all sales appointments and conduct in-home product demonstrations of Windows, Siding, & Doors.

• Maximize the conversion of leads to sales

• Ownership of the Customer through coordination with Feldco’s Call Center, Finance & Fulfillment departments

• Utilize sales and problem-solving skills to better serve external and internal customers

• Achieve or exceed individual sales goals and company sales metrics standards

• Ensure an exceptional and delightful experience for all Feldco customers


Additional Information


• Base salary and lucrative commission structure


• Average total compensation over $80,000 per year


• 25% of Outside Sales Representatives earning $100,000-$200,000 per year


• Unlimited earning potential


• Paid Sales training


• Industry-best customer sales leads


• Benefits - (Medical, Dental, Vision, Vol Life, STD, LTD, 401 K, and Paid Time Off)


• Career Advancement

post.description: To enumerate a company's openings, e.g. from a pasted careers.smartrecruiters.com/<company> or api.smartrecruiters.com/v1/companies/<company>/postings URL. Pass next_cursor back as cursor until it is null; use get_job for a posting's full text and salary.

company.description: SmartRecruiters company identifier: the first path segment of jobs.smartrecruiters.com/<company> (e.g. ServiceNow, BoschGroup). find_companies resolves a name to it. Matched case-insensitively upstream. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,99}$.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous call; omit to start. Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,5}(\.[0-9]{1,5}\.[0-9]{1,5})?$.

location.description: Case-insensitive text matched against each posting's location (city, region, country, or the career-site group heading), e.g. Bangalore.

query.description: Keywords, as typed into the career site's search box.

url.description: A pasted company URL: careers.smartrecruiters.com/<company>[/<brand page>], jobs.smartrecruiters.com/<company>, or api.smartrecruiters.com/v1/companies/<company>/postings (parsed only; the API host is never contacted). Exactly one of company or url. Pattern: ^https?://((jobs|careers|www|api)\.)?smartrecruiters\.com/[A-Za-z0-9].

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
Every posting of one SmartRecruiters company, with keyword and location filters. A company whose openings all fit in SmartRecruiters search (100 or fewer) comes back in one call with posting dates and structured locations; larger ones are walked through the company's career site group by group (groups are usually locations), up to 8 site pages per call, with a resumable cursor until next_cursor is null.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `items` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `employment_type` | string | e.g. Full-time, when the career site prints it. |
| `group` | string | Career-site group heading the posting is listed under; null for search listings. |
| `group_size` | number | Postings the career site counts in that group. |
| `id` | string | Posting id; pass to get_job with company. |
| `location` | object | Structured fields are filled when the listing came from search; career-site listings carry the group heading as label. |
| `reference` | string | The employer's requisition reference when the career site shows one (e.g. JB0074763). |
| `released_at` | string | Publication instant, RFC 3339 UTC; search listings only (career-site lists do not print it, get_job does). |
| `tags` | string[] | Short facts the career site prints under the title. |
| `title` | string |  |
| `url` | string |  |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.
